armySpecialRules.name: Elven Grace
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+)
special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be
used against enemies that attack before the model with
Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: Eternal Hatred
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Hatred special
rule in addition to Hatred (High Elves).

armySpecialRules.name: Hekarti'S Blessing
armySpecialRules.description:
A Wizard with this special rule adds +1 to all attempts
to cast spells.

armySpecialRules.name: Murderous Prowess
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule may re-roll all To Wound
rolls of 1 when making close combat attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: Khainite
armySpecialRules.description:
Characters who are Khainites (except models
deploying using the Hidden special rule) may only join
units which are also Khainites, and characters who are
not Khainites may not join Khainite units.

armySpecialRules.name: Sea Dragon Cloak
armySpecialRules.description:
A Sea Dragon Cloak gives the wearer the Natural
Armour (5+) special rule against missile attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: Deathrain Crossbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Deathrain crossbows have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24" 2 Multiple Shots (3),
Rapid Fire

armySpecialRules.name: Repeater Handbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Repeater handbows have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12" 2 Multiple Shots (3),
Rapid Fire,
Quick to Fire

magicItems.name: Chillblade
magicItems.description:
Attacks made with the Chillblade wound automatically
and have the Ice Attacks special rule. For each unsaved
Wound suffered from the Chillblade, the target suffers
-1 to its Attacks characteristic until the end of this
Close Combat phase.

magicItems.name: Venomfang Blade
magicItems.description:
Khainite Assassin only. Any model that suffers an
unsaved Wound from this weapon must pass a
Toughness test on a 2D6 or automatically lose all
remaining wounds.

magicItems.name: Executioner'S Axe
magicItems.description:
Infantry only. Great weapon. In close combat, the
wielder of the Executioner's Axe counts as having a
Strength double that of their target's Toughness. In
addition, any attacks made with the Executioner's Axe
have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.
Furthermore, the wielder gains the Khainite special
rule.

magicItems.name: Shade Claw
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains the Ignores Armour
saves special rule. In addition, no Parry saves may be
taken against it.

magicItems.name: Lifetaker
magicItems.description:
Deathrain crossbow. Lifetaker fires using the following
profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
30" 4 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (3)
Lifetaker ignores all To Hit modifiers.

magicItems.name: Soulrender
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. Attacks made with Soulrender have the
Ignores Armour saves special rule. In addition, the
wielder gains the Khainite special rule.

magicItems.name: Web Of Shadows
magicItems.description:
One use only. The model can choose to use the Web of
Shadows in addition to their normal attacks. When
used, one model in base contact with the character
automatically takes 2D6 Strength 3 hits. Wounds
caused do not carry over on to other models.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Dark
found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Spite
magicItems.description:
Any To Hit roll of 5+ with the Blade of Spite
automatically Wounds. Armour saves apply as normal.
This has no effect on models with Immunity (Poisoned
Attacks).

magicItems.name: Crone Blade
magicItems.description:
Hag Queen or Death Hag only. Roll a D6 each time the
wielder of this weapon causes an unsaved Wound in
close combat. On the roll of a 4+, they regain 1 Wound
suffered earlier during the game.
magicItems.restriction: Hag Queen or Death Hag only.

magicItems.name: Deathpiercer
magicItems.description:
Heavy lance. Attacks made with Deathpiercer have the
Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Draich Of Dark Power
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Great Weapon. The wielder of the
Draich of Dark Power ignores the normal Initiative
penalties from great weapons and gains the Killing
Blow special rule. In addition, the wielder gains the
Khainite special rule.

magicItems.name: Shadesliver
magicItems.description:
Additional hand weapon. After every round of close
combat in which the bearer of this item inflicts one or
more Unsaved Wounds, this weapon gains +1 Strength
for the remainder of the battle. This effect is
cumulative.

magicItems.name: The Mirror Glaive
magicItems.description:
Polearm. Each time an enemy spell cast at the bearer of
this weapon or the unit they are with is dispelled, you
may attempt to cast the same spell back as if it was a
Bound Spell, using your Dispel dice as if they were
Power dice. The enemy may then attempt to dispel it
using their Power dice.

magicItems.name: Shadracar'S Fang
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and the
Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Ruin
magicItems.description:
Attacks made with the Sword of Ruin have the Armour
Piercing (4) special rule.

magicItems.name: Caledor'S Bane
magicItems.description:
Heavy lance. Caledor's Bane gives the wielder the
Devastating Charge special rule, and attacks made with
it ignore Natural Armour.

magicItems.name: Heartseeker
magicItems.description:
The model wielding Heartseeker may re-roll all failed
rolls To Hit and To Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: Hydra Blade
magicItems.description:
The wielder of the Hydra Blade has the Random
Attacks (D6) special rule in addition to their normal
attacks.

magicItems.name: Dagger Of Hotek
magicItems.description:
Additional hand weapon. The Dagger of Hotek gives
the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Living Death
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer gains +1 Toughness and +1
Wound. However, they also become subject to
Stupidity.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Eternal Servitude
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of the Armour of Eternal
Servitude gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of Hag Graef
magicItems.description:
Sea Dragon Cloak. Any missile attack on a model
wearing the Cloak of Hag Graef has its Strength halved
(rounding up) before rolling To Wound.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Darkness
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Armour of Darkness gives the
wearer a 1+ armour save.

magicItems.name: Shield Of Ghrond
magicItems.description:
Shield. The Shield of Ghrond causes all Hits on the
model to be resolved with -1 Strength.

magicItems.name: Blood Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. For every unsaved wound the wearer of
the Blood Armour inflicts in close combat, their armour
save is improved by one point to a maximum total of
1+ for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: The Black Amulet
magicItems.description:
The wearer of the Black Amulet has a Ward save (4+).
In addition, each time the bearer of the Black Amulet
makes a successful Ward save in close combat, the
Black Amulet inflicts one Wound which Ignores
Armour saves on the opponent that struck the blow.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Black Iron
magicItems.description:
The Crown of Black Iron gives the bearer a 5+ Ward
save, +1 Leadership and the Magic Resistance (1)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Hotek
magicItems.description:
The bearer has the Magic Resistance (3) special rule.
Any enemy Wizard that attempts to cast or target a
spell on a unit within 12" of the bearer will suffer a
miscast on a roll of double 6, as well as double 1.

magicItems.name: Pendant Of Khaeleth
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The Pendant of Khaeleth gives the
bearer a Ward Save based upon the Strength of the hit.
Roll a D6 for every wound suffered by the wearer; on a
roll lower than the Strength of the Attack, the Wound is
saved. Rolls of 6 always fail.

magicItems.name: Heart-Stone Of Darkness
magicItems.description:
The Heart-stone of Darkness gives the bearer the Ward
Save (4+) special rule against close combat attacks.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Darkness
magicItems.description:
The Ring of Darkness causes all close combat attacks
directed against the bearer to be resolved at half their
normal Weapon Skill (rounding up). Any missile
attacks directed at the model or their unit resolved at
half their normal Ballistic Skill (rounding up).

magicItems.name: Shadowshroud Ring
magicItems.description:
One use only. This ring may be used at the start of any
of your turns. Until the start of your next turn, no
enemy units can declare a charge or target the unit with
spells or missile attacks unless they are within 6" of the
bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: Seal Of Ghrond
magicItems.description:
The Seal of Ghrond adds +1 Dispel dice to your dispel
pool at the start of every enemy Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Amber Amulet
magicItems.description:
The wearer of the Amber Amulet gains the
Regeneration (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of Twilight
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The wearer of the Cloak of
Twilight has a Ward save (2+) against Wounds caused
by enemy shooting attacks and spells.

magicItems.name: Incorporeal Retainer
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. All enemy models attacking the bearer of
this item must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: Null Talisman
magicItems.description:
The model carrying the Null Talisman, and any unit
they are with, gains a +2 bonus to dispel enemy spells
targeting them directly.

magicItems.name: Charm Of Hotek
magicItems.description:
The model wearing the Charm of Hotek gains a 6+
Armour Save and the Immunity (Flaming Attacks)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Black Staff
magicItems.description:
Whenever the bearer casts a spell, they may add an
additional free power dice to the result after rolling the
dice. However, if this extra dice rolls a 1, the Wizard
suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: Shadow Stone
magicItems.description:
When casting spells from the Lore of Shadow, the
Wizard gains a +1 casting bonus and may re-roll a
single roll of a natural 1 per casting attempt.

magicItems.name: The Sacrificial Dagger
magicItems.description:
Once per casting attempt, after the casting dice are
rolled but before a dispel attempt is made, the bearer of
this magic item can sacrifice one model in her unit.
Choose which model is sacrificed - it is immediately
removed as a casualty with no saves of any kind
allowed - then roll a D6. On a 2+, the Sorceress gains
an extra power dice that must be rolled and added to
the casting result; dispel attempts can now be made and
the spell resolved. This can be used to allow the Wizard
to use more dice than is normally allowed by their
Wizard level. On a roll of a 1, the sacrifice has not
generated enough power - you can either immediately
sacrifice another model from the unit and roll again,
following the procedure above, or accept the original
casting result (if the bearer is the only model remaining
in the unit, no further sacrifices can be attempted).

magicItems.name: Tome Of Furion
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Tome of Furion gains the Loremaster
(Lore of Dark Magic) special rule.

magicItems.name: Soulstone
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Soulstone makes the Sorceress
immune to the effects of her first Miscast.

magicItems.name: Focus Familiar
magicItems.description:
The Focus Familiar allows the wielder to cast spells
from a different position on the battlefield. Place a
marker at the start of each Dark Elf Magic phase within
6" of the Wizard and at least 1" away from units or
impassable terrain. They may use this position when
determining range and line of sight for their spells.

magicItems.name: Darkstar Cloak
magicItems.description:
The Darkstar Cloak gives the Wizard +1 Power dice in
each of your Magic phases. Only they may use this
extra dice.

magicItems.name: Crystal Heart
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may choose to cast the same
spell twice per Magic phase. However, every time they
choose to do so, roll a D6 first. On the roll of a 1, the
model suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: The Gem Of Spite
magicItems.description:
Whenever the bearer suffers a miscast, the Gem of
Spite inflicts a single Strength 6 hit on every enemy
Wizard within 18".

magicItems.name: Wand Of The Kharaidon
magicItems.description:
When casting the Doombolt spell from the Lore of
Dark Magic, you may re-roll the number of Hits
caused.

magicItems.name: Anklet Of Epiphany
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains +6" to the range of their
spells if they are within 6" of a terrain feature.

magicItems.name: Black Dragon Egg
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer may consume this item at the
start of any player turn. For the rest of that turn, the
consumer has Strength and Toughness 6, and the
Noxious Breath special rule.

magicItems.name: Asphyxica Censer
magicItems.description:
Disciple of Khaine only. At the start of each round of
close combat, all enemy models in base contact with
the bearer must take a Toughness test or suffer a
Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Woe
magicItems.description:
Hag Queen or Death Hag only. Enemy units cannot use
the Inspiring Presence special rule while they are
within 6" of the bearer of this item. After the bearer has
slain one or more models in close combat, the range is
increased to 12" for the remainder of the game.
magicItems.restriction: Hag Queen or Death Hag only.

magicItems.name: Deathmask
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Deathmask causes Terror.

magicItems.name: Rubric Of Dark Dimensions
magicItems.description:
Bound spell. Power level 5. The Rubric of Dark
Dimensions contains a direct damage spell which
targets all enemy models in base contact with the
caster. The target models must pass a Strength test for
each Wound on their profile or suffer a Wound which
Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: Decanter Of Egos
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. One use only. This item can be used at the
start of any of your turns. For the duration of the turn,
all friendly units within 6" gain +3 to their Movement
characteristic.

magicItems.name: The Hydra'S Teeth
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Hydra's Teeth can be used at the
start of any close combat phase. Once used, they inflict
5D6 Weapon Skill 2, Strength 3 Attacks on one enemy
unit in base contact.

magicItems.name: The Guiding Eye
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Guiding Eye and any unit they are
with may re-roll 1's To Hit with missile weapons.

magicItems.name: Pearl Of Infinite Bleakness
magicItems.description:
The model bearing the Pearl of Infinite Bleakness and
any unit they are with gain the Immunity (Psychology)
special rule. In addition, any enemy unit in base contact
with the bearer suffers -1 to their Leadership. This has
no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: Crystal Of Midnight
magicItems.description:
Nominate another enemy Wizard within 12" at the start
of any Dark Elves turn. The Wizard must pass a
Leadership test or lose one randomly determined spell
for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: The Cloak Of Dark Souls
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The wearer of the Cloak of Dark
Souls gains the Hidden and Scouts special rules.

magicItems.name: Orb Of Ghrond
magicItems.description:
The model carrying the Orb of Ghrond may consult it
at the start of each of your turns as long as they are not
in close combat. If they do so, they must take a
Stupidity test. If passed, the model may re-roll all
failed rolls To Hit and re-roll one power or dispel dice
when casting or dispelling until the start of your next
turn.

magicItems.name: Sevenfold Shadow
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. One use only. Instead of moving
normally in the Remaining Moves sub-phase, the
model may be moved to anywhere on the battlefield, as
long as they do not end their move within 6" of any
enemy unit or 1" of impassable terrain.

magicItems.name: Gem Of Nightmares
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Gem of Nightmares can be used at
the start of any turn. Until the end of that turn, the
model and any unit it is with has the Fear special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Nagarythe
magicItems.description:
All friendly units of Dark Elves within 12" of this
standard gain the Eternal Hatred special rule.

magicItems.name: Hydra Banner
magicItems.description:
All models in the unit carrying this standard gain +1
Attack in the first round of any close combat (including
mounts).

magicItems.name: Standard Of Hag Graef
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Always
Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Cold Blood
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Cold-Blooded
special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Murder
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard adds an additional D6"
to their charge range.

magicItems.name: The Blood Banner
magicItems.description:
Cold One Knights only. The unit carrying this banner
do not need to take Stupidity tests caused by Cold
Ones.

magicItems.name: Sea Serpent Standard
magicItems.description:
Corsairs only. The unit carrying this standard gains the
Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Har Ganeth
magicItems.description:
Executioners only. The unit carrying this standard
causes Terror.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Slaughter
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains +D3 to their
combat resolution bonus on any turn the unit charges.

magicItems.name: Sacrificial Banner
magicItems.description:
All enemy Monsters with Line of Sight to the unit
carrying this standard gain the Berserk Rage portion of
the Frenzy special rule against it. In addition, they
suffer a -3 Leadership modifier for any Berserk Rage
tests against the unit bearing this standard.

magicItems.name: Soul Shadows Standard
magicItems.description:
If the unit carrying this standard chooses Flee as a
charge reaction it automatically rallies at the end of
their Flee move (as long as the charging unit does not
reach it).

magicItems.name: Traitor'S Banner
magicItems.description:
Enemy units attempting to target the unit carrying this
standard with missile attacks or spells must pass a
Leadership test. If failed, they must choose another
target.

loresOfMagic.name: Dark Magic
loresOfMagic.attribute:
When a Wizard successfully casts a hex, magic missile
or direct damage spell from this lore, and the casting
roll contains any double, the spell's target suffers 2D6
Strength 2 hits after the spell has been resolved. If the
casting roll contains any treble, the spell's target instead
suffers 3D6 hits instead.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Dance Of Doom
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Model on foot only. Enemies targeting the model must
re-roll all successful To Hit rolls with missile weapons
and in close combat.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Cry Of War
gifts_of_khaine.description:
All enemy units in base contact with the wearer suffer
-1 To Hit in the first round of close combat. This has no
effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

gifts_of_khaine.name: Rending Stars
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Khainite Assassin only. Rending Stars are missile
weapons with the following profile.
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12" As user +1 Multiple Shots (3),
Quick to Fire

gifts_of_khaine.name: Touch Of Death
gifts_of_khaine.description: The model gains the Killing Blow special rule.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Witchbrew
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Death Hag and Hag Queens only. This model, and all
models in the same unit, gain the Frenzy special rule
and can never lose their Frenzy.
gifts_of_khaine.restriction: Death Hag and Hag Queens only.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Hand Of Khaine
gifts_of_khaine.description:
All enemy units in base contact suffer a -1 penalty to
their Weapon Skill and Initiative.
e army list. A model may not have multiples of the same
model in the army.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Rune Of Khaine
gifts_of_khaine.description:
The model gains the Random Attacks (D3) special rule
in addition to its normal attacks.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Black Lotus
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Khainite Assassin only. Each unsaved Wound caused in
Close Combat counts as two for the purpose of combat
resolution. This has no effect against models with
Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: Blood Sigil
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Disciple of Khaine only. The model may re-roll failed
Leadership tests when using Blood Rites. However, if
they roll double 6's on the second roll, they will suffer a
Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

gifts_of_khaine.name: Dark Venom
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Khainite Assassin only. A model with Dark Venom
gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule (including
missile attacks). This has no effect against models with
Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: Manbane
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Khainite Assassin only. A model with Manbane will
automatically Wound on the roll of a 2+ (including
missile attacks). This has no effect against models with
Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: Khainite Pendant
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Disciple of Khaine only. One use only. The model may
attempt to use two Blood Rites this turn.
